name: placed-agent
title: Placed agent
description: PlacedAgentWorkspace: AgentWorkspace over ONE controller, as a page (the app's Agent tab) or collapsed beside the app. Collapsed on a wide screen it is a floating AmbientChat; on a phone inside an app shell the same controller is lent to the shell's bottom drawer (useAgentLoan of app-shell), so one chat drawer serves the app. Outside a shell on a phone it stays the page. Placement is remembered (usePlacedAgentState) or controlled; usePlacedAgent gives collapse and expand to buttons inside it. The page stays mounted while collapsed, so its open file survives. Layout only: Pi owns the conversation.
